SOCIAL STUDIES — MOCK EXAM #17
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Compass Direction is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Compass Direction with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Compass Direction never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Compass Direction as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Compass Direction.

2. Which statement about Enterprise Project at School is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Enterprise Project at School with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Enterprise Project at School never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Enterprise Project at School.
   D. Treat Enterprise Project at School as rumours only.

3. Which statement about Industries in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Industries in the County.
   B. Treat Industries in the County as rumours only.
   C. Explain Industries in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Industries in the County never happens in Kenya.

4. Which statement about Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. as rumours only.
   C. Explain Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County..

5. Which statement about Location and size of the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Location and size of the County.
   B. Explain Location and size of the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Location and size of the County never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Location and size of the County as rumours only.

6. Which statement about Economic activities in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Economic activities in the County as rumours only.
   B. Say Economic activities in the County never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Economic activities in the County.
   D. Explain Economic activities in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Destroying road signs
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Avoiding all community work
   D. Obeying laws and caring for public property

8. Which statement about Interdependence of people is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Interdependence of people with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Interdependence of people never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Interdependence of people as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Interdependence of people.

9. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Plan income and spending wisely
   B. Avoid saving forever
   C. Hide all money underground
   D. Ignore prices in shops

10. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Mombasa
   B. Nairobi
   C. Kisumu
   D. Nakuru

11. Which statement about The School is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing The School.
   B. Say The School never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain The School with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat The School as rumours only.

12. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Explain symbols used on a map
   B. Replace the compass rose
   C. Name the president
   D. Measure rainfall only

13. Which statement about Population Distribution is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Population Distribution with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Population Distribution.
   C. Say Population Distribution never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Population Distribution as rumours only.

14. Which statement about Seasons in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Seasons in the County.
   B. Explain Seasons in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Seasons in the County as rumours only.
   D. Say Seasons in the County never happens in Kenya.

15. Which statement about Historic Built Environments in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Historic Built Environments in the County never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Historic Built Environments in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Historic Built Environments in the County.
   D. Treat Historic Built Environments in the County as rumours only.

16. Which statement about Physical features in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Physical features in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Physical features in the County.
   C. Say Physical features in the County never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Physical features in the County as rumours only.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Location and size of the County and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Physical features in the County and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Seasons in the County and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Historic Built Environments in the County and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Interdependence of people and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Population Distribution and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain The School and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
